Sony's official professional grade PlayStation DualSense Edge controller is much nicer than the standard DualSense controller, and a worthy upgrade for the upcoming Grand Theft Auto 6 game, but it retails for $200. Fortunately, for a limited time, there's a way to get it even for much less.

Sony PlayStation DualSense Edge Controller for $121.97

Used "Like New" Condition

PlayStation 5 DualSense Edge Controller

Amazon Resale is current offering a Used "Like New" Sony PlayStation 5 DualSense Edge Controller for just $121.97 with free shipping after an automatic 30% discount is applied during checkout. Amazon Resale is Amazon's official outlet for used items. Amazon states that this "Like New" item "looks and functions as if it were new and comes in original packaging." You still get the 30-day Amazon return policy so it's safer than buying off Facebook Marketplace.

The DualSense Edge is Sony's official high-end controller for the PS5 console. It offers pro-level features like grips, adjustable analog sticks, mappable rear buttons, profiles, and more. They're very useful for gamers who invest time into esports or enjoy playing competitive games like first person shooters and fighting games.

One of the most important features of any pro controller are the thumbsticks and triggers. The sticks on the DualSense Edge are interchangeable; you can choose domed or convex replacements that come in two different heights. If your analog sticks crap out, you can buy replacements for $19.99. The DualSense Edge comes standard with traditional potentiometer-based analog sticks, but some third party manufacturers now make aftermarket TMR versions.

There are also two sets of interchangeable back buttons that can be mapped to any button on the DualSense Edge controller. For Grand Theft Auto 6, the paddle switches might be used for weapon switching, sprinting or rolling in firefights, braking during car chases, or other actions that might normally force you to take your thumbs of the sticks.

The triggers, likewise, have received special treatment as well. Next to each trigger is a stop slider that lets you adjust how far you have to press the trigger down to make it register. You can choose standard, medium, or short travel distances.

Accessories include a hard shell case anda 9 foot long USB-C cable. All-in-all, it's a significant upgrade from the standard DualSense controller and, with this deal, worth the price premium.
